findings.F1: Sense 1 example uses the ungrammatical 'Although ..., but ...' pattern.
findings.F2: The no-but rule is stated in three fields (explanation, adaptation.grammar, learner_errors).
findings.F3: if-conj listed in compare without being a real confusable.
findings.F4: when-conj listed in compare without being a real confusable.
findings.F5: The even-though strength point is repeated in compare and in synonym_discrimination.
findings.F6: False etymology from Latin alter through French; the true origin is al + though.
findings.F7: Synonym discrimination reverses register: though is the informal, spoken word, although the more formal.
